title: Some people aren’t stuck because they lack talent.
paragraphs: Some people aren’t stuck because they lack talent.
They’re stuck because they’re addicted to certainty.
The servant in Gospel of Matthew 25 thought he was being careful.

He buried what he was given.
Called it wisdom.
Called it patience.
Called it “waiting for the right time.”

This isn’t about money.
It’s about trust.
If God trusted you with capacity, influence, skill, insight — growth is not optional. It’s stewardship.

Not reckless expansion.
Not ego-driven scaling.
But faithful multiplication.
The mature know the difference between patience and avoidance.

One waits in obedience.
The other waits in hiding.

Are you being patient?
Or are you protecting yourself from exposure?
